info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update External Agency By Param1-spec
info.description: The External Agency Management API enables efficient updates to external agency records within the interbank relationship management system. Utilizing the PATCH method, this endpoint allows authorized users to modify specific attributes of an external agency based on a unique identifier (param1). This API is ideal for financial institutions and banking systems that require real-time adjustments to external agency information for compliance and operational efficiency. Typical consumers of this API include banking application developers and integration specialists seeking to enhance their interbank relationship management processes.
